description: Financial reports with charts/visualizations, budget management, data export, and search/filter functionality
steps: Add Chart.js via CDN (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js) to index.html for data visualizations.

Implement the Laporan (Reports) page with three sub-sections toggled by tabs: Ringkasan (Summary), Kategori (By Category), Tren (Trend). Ringkasan shows: total income vs expense for selected period (month picker), net savings, comparison with previous month (percentage change). Kategori shows: donut/pie chart of expenses by category with legend showing amounts and percentages, and a similar one for income. Tren shows: line chart of daily spending for the current month, and a bar chart comparing monthly totals for the last 6 months.

Implement Budget Management on the Pengaturan (Settings) page or as a sub-page accessible from settings. Features: set monthly budget per expense category (e.g., Makanan Rp 2.000.000), view budget progress bars showing spent vs budget with percentage, color-code progress bars (green <75%, yellow 75-90%, red >90%), show total monthly budget vs total spent. Store budgets in localStorage via Storage.getBudgets()/setBudget().

Add a dedicated Budget page accessible from Settings (#budget) showing all category budgets as cards with progress bars, an 'Edit Budget' button per category that opens an inline edit form, and a summary card at top showing total budget vs total spent this month.

Implement Search and Filter on the Riwayat/Transactions page (#transactions). Add a search input at top that filters transactions by description text (real-time as user types). Add filter controls: filter by type (Semua/Pemasukan/Pengeluaran), filter by category (dropdown of all categories), filter by date range (dari-sampai date pickers). Show result count. Maintain filters across navigation (store in session state).

Implement Data Export functionality accessible from Settings page. Export options: Export as CSV (downloads a .csv file with columns: Tanggal, Tipe, Kategori, Deskripsi, Jumlah), Export as JSON (full data backup). Use Blob + URL.createObjectURL + temporary anchor element pattern for download. Add an Import JSON option that reads a previously exported JSON file and merges/replaces data with confirmation dialog.

Add a Statistik card on the Dashboard (#home) below the summary cards: show 'Pengeluaran Terbesar' (largest expense this month with category and amount), 'Rata-rata Pengeluaran Harian' (average daily expense), and 'Jumlah Transaksi' (transaction count this month). Also add a small spending trend sparkline or mini bar chart (last 7 days) using Chart.js.

Add monthly comparison feature in Reports: show income/expense comparison between current month and previous month with arrows indicating increase/decrease and percentage change, styled with green (positive) and red (negative) indicators.
acceptance_criteria: Reports page displays three tabs (Ringkasan, Kategori, Tren) that switch content
Pie/donut chart correctly shows expense distribution by category with actual data from localStorage
Line chart shows daily spending trend for the current month
Bar chart shows last 6 months comparison (even if some months have no data)
Budget page allows setting a Rupiah budget amount per expense category
Budget progress bars show correct percentage of budget used with color coding
Search on transactions page filters results in real-time as user types
Type filter (Semua/Pemasukan/Pengeluaran) correctly filters transaction list
Category filter correctly shows only transactions of selected category
CSV export downloads a valid CSV file with all transactions
JSON export downloads complete data that can be re-imported
JSON import successfully restores data from a previously exported file
Dashboard statistics card shows correct calculated values
All charts are responsive and render correctly on mobile viewport (max 480px)
Charts update when new transactions are added
verification: Add several transactions across different categories and dates, then navigate to Reports and verify charts render with correct data
Set a budget for 'Makanan & Minuman' category, add expense transactions in that category, verify progress bar shows correct percentage
Type a search term on Transactions page and verify the list filters in real-time
Use category and type filters and verify correct filtering
Click Export CSV, open the downloaded file, verify it contains correct transaction data
Click Export JSON, then clear all data, then Import the JSON file and verify data is restored
Verify charts are visible and readable at mobile viewport width (375px-480px)
